status: DRAFT — host-only. The §4 instrument batch is implemented against this draft; nothing here authorises a build, a ruling or board contact. `pinned_at_build.app_image_sha256` and `prereg.sha256` are null until the two-operator image (§2) is built, reviewed and pinned and the preregistration is frozen; host/l6_runner.py refuses to run while either is null.

prereg.frozen_when: sha256 recorded here and every later artifact pins it (prereg header)

pinned_at_build.watchdog_note: D-s1: arm and kick gated by identity-page flags.bit1; bit1 = 0 must behave exactly as L5; the build and its tests pin the ACTUAL load value written (this number), not the derivation
pinned_at_build.operator_image_note: §2.1: the map data compiled in must hash to operator.operator_data_sha256, regenerated on the host from the pinned local_map.json by host/l6_operators.py

schedule.rule: A,B,B,A across successive seed pairs (Claim B prereg §4): candidates 2k and 2k+1 share pair seed k; pair 0 = A,B; pair 1 = B,A; …
schedule.pair_seed: xorshift64 warm-up over ((master_seed<<32 | master_seed) ^ (pair+1)*golden), upper 32 bits — host/l6_schedule.py:pair_seed, twin required in the image
schedule.seq_index: seq 1 = opening baseline, seq i+2 = candidate index i, seq N+2 = closing baseline

operator.derivation: host/l6_operators.py:operator_data over the phenotype manifest + local_map.json: the 292 addresses in genome bit order, each LUT's genome bits in INIT-index order
operator.mutation_bits_note: DRAFT pin, both arms: random-safe = 4 addresses uniform without replacement over the 292; map-guided = one LUT uniform over the map's six, then 4 of its mapped INIT positions. The rate does not depend on it (every candidate rewrites all twelve frames); Claim B's own preregistration fixes its value for the arms at its freeze — this pin is for the instrument's twin and calibration only.

audit.scheduled: every 16th seq + first and last candidate (seq 2, N+1) + both baselines (seq 1, N+2) — host/l6_schedule.py:sampled_audit_seqs, requested by AUDITREQ
audit.auto: §3a item 2: every non-SCORED self-report (STOP_LINK2, STOP_LINK3, REFUSED_BY_PL, STOP_ARM, STOP_SETTLE) audited unconditionally by the firmware before its record — a firmware change for the §2 image; the validator requires it now (validators.records.check_audit_policy policy='sampled')
audit.exempt: REFUSED_BY_GATE and a pre-staging STOP_AXI (no raw words exist)

frames.crc_budget: ceil(4 × expected_protocol_frames / 1000), expected from N + the audit schedule + these brackets BEFORE the session (D-s4); any missing AUDIT/REC/TERM is a structural HOLD independently

calibration.note: D-s3: filled by the owner after C1 and C2; the S runner imports rate_A/rate_B ONLY from rate reports whose bytes hash to these pins

wire_additions.loop_record: 1.1.0 adds `arm` ∈ {random_safe, map_guided} on candidate records; absent on the two baselines
wire_additions.run_log: adds `timing` (host-written: clocks + per-record stage times) and `l6` (schedule, expected frames, budget inputs)
